https://www.linkedin.com/in/shubham-jain-2b38089a/

SUMMARY

Innovative and impact-driven AI professional with 11 years of experience in designing and deploying advanced AI/ML/GenAI solutions across Healthcare,

Banking, Retail, and Manufacturing. Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, architect scalable AI platforms, and translate business needs into

actionable AI strategies. Adept at working with LLMs, RAG, multi-agent systems, and cloud-native tools to deliver high-impact enterprise solutions that

reduce costs and drive efficiency.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Agentic AI

Generative AI

Artificial Intelligence

Natural Language Processing

Machine Learning

Prompt Engineering

Azure

Dev Ops

Databricks

MLOps

Predictive & Statistical modelling

RAG

ReAct

Data visualization

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior AI Scientist

Apr '20



Present

AI Labs at Course5 Intelligence Pvt. Ltd.

Bangalore, IN

Leading AI initiatives across Fortune 500 clients, with end-to-end ownership of design, architecture, deployment, and optimization of GenAI and ML solutions.



Streamlined enterprise information retrieval for a global FMCG client by deploying a multi-agent chatbot on Azure Databricks, architected with

LangGraph and ReAct-based RAG framework.



Established a complete LLMOps lifecycle using MLflow for production tracing, prompt registry, capture user feedback, and “LLM-as-a-judge”

scoring all operationalized via CI/CD pipeline.



Deployed an end-to-end GenAI analytics platform on Azure for a Fortune 500 healthcare client, leveraging LangChain RAG architecture with BERT for

intent recognition to handle complex Text-to-SQL queries, all automated via CI/CD and ADF pipelines to cut manual reporting by 80%.



Implemented advanced Text-to-SQL capabilities on Databricks Genie, strengthening data governance and security with user-level access control via

Unity Catalog.



Fine-tuned a Mistral 7B model for a text-to-SQL task, leveraging QLORA PEFT technique and 8/4-bit quantization to reduce memory footprint and

lower inference latency.



Developed a knowledge management solution employing Azure Cognitive Services and azure search to automate metadata tagging and document

summarization, resulting in a 70% reduction in manual effort.



Led the pre-sales process for GenAI and ML solutions, designing complex agentic AI architectures and developing impactful proofs-of-concept with

detailed API and cost modeling to secure key enterprise accounts.



Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders (product, engineering, business) to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise workflows.



Mentoring a 5-member AI team while leading Agile ceremonies to accelerate development velocity and establishing best practices in AI/ML

development and delivery.

Senior Data Scientist

Oct '18 Mar '20 -

Tata Consultancy Services

Bangalore, IN

Delivered predictive ML solutions for clients in banking and manufacturing, with a focus on scalable deployment and measurable business impact.

•

Boosted cross-sell conversion by 20% for a major bank by engineering an automated ML pipeline that used Logistic Regression and Random Forest

models for batch inference and retraining, delivering actionable churn predictions and sales leads directly to a performance dashboard.

•

Built an ML-powered claims settlement engine for a paper board manufacturing client using a predictive scoring model with Logistic Regression and

Weight of Evidence (WOE) technique, which automated 82% of submissions and slashed processing time from 25 days to one.



Ensured model transparency by analyzing model coefficients and applying post-hoc techniques like SHAP, LIME, and Feature Importance for local

and global model explanations.

Data Scientist

Aug '17 Oct '18 -

Mercedes Benz R&D India

Bangalore,IN

Pioneered analytics solutions for automotive warranty, diagnostics, and reporting processes.



Improved warranty cost forecasting by developing ML models (SVR, Random Forest) and deploying their outputs into a dynamic dashboard,

empowering the finance department to more confidently allocate reserves and anticipate liabilities based on Repairs Per Hundred Engines (RPH) and

Cost Per Engine (CPE) KPIs.



Automated reporting pipeline using Python and rule-based NLG to translate SQL data into weekly KPI presentations, slashing manual effort by 90%.



Executed a rigorous model selection process by benchmarking multiple algorithms through k-fold cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning to

identify the model with the lowest prediction error (RMSE/MAE) on business KPIs.

Software Developer

Aug '14



Aug '17

Robert Bosch India

Coimbatore,IN

Delivered IoT and analytics-backed solutions for automotive use cases, with emphasis on cost and process optimization.



Developed a hybrid predictive maintenance engine for BEV powertrains, integrating statistical analysis, rule-based logic, and anomaly detection

models to cut operational costs by $5M through proactive fault detection.



Designed data visualizations in Tableau to enhance analytical storytelling and decision-making.



Automated data extraction and cleansing pipelines, while ensuring robust delivery via unit and integration testing.

Tools

LLMs: GPT4o , Sonnet, Gemini

Frameworks: Pytorch, Tensorflow, Keras, MLflow

Databases: SQL, MongoDB, CosmosDB, Neo4J

Languages: Python, R

Operating system: Linux, Windows

Libraries: Langchain, HuggingFace, LangGraph, Spacy

EDUCATION

B.Tech - Electrical & Electronics Engineering

Jul '10 May '14 -

NIT Trichy

Tiruchirappalli, TN

Certifications



Microsoft certified Azure AI Engineer Associate| Jan 2025



Neo4j Certified Professional | Mar 2022



Coursera Deep learning Specialization | Mar 2019



Coursera Machine Learning Course by Andrew Ng | May 2017
